sources.entry: xlsxwriter - A Python module for creating Excel .xlsx files.

summary.one_liner: XlsxWriter is a standard-library-only Python module for writing Excel 2007+ .xlsx files with text, numbers, formulas, formatting, charts and images.
summary.what_it_does: The module creates new XLSX workbooks and writes text, numbers, formulas and hyperlinks to multiple worksheets. It supports cell formatting, merged cells, defined names, and autofilters. It can also add charts, data validation and drop-down lists, conditional formatting, and images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, WMF, EMF). Other features listed include rich multi-format strings, cell comments, textboxes, and macros. The README says it integrates with Pandas and Polars and has a memory optimization mode for large files. The README example builds a small workbook with a column width, a bold format, and an inserted image.
use_cases: export pandas or polars dataframes to xlsx
add conditional formatting and data validation to workbooks
write very large Excel files with low memory
insert images or comments into spreadsheets
notable: Writes only; the README does not describe reading or editing existing xlsx files
Memory optimization mode for writing large files
Charts, conditional formatting, data validation, and images in one module
Integration with Pandas and Polars named in the README
caveats: The README does not state a license, so this summary records the license as unknown
The README excerpt lacks links to the full documentation and release notes
Writes new files; the README does not describe modifying existing workbooks
